summary: Diff implements a 4-theme toggle (White/Black/Orange/Yellow) via `useTheme` with localStorage persistence and light/dark backward compatibility, applies theme via `data-theme` (and `dark` class for Black), updates `ThemeToggleBar` to cycle themes with updated aria-labels, and uses semantic tokens (`bg-primary`, `bg-accent`, `ring-ring`) for the indicator. Global theme CSS variables were updated in `frontend/src/index.css` for at least White/Black/Orange; the file is truncated so Yellow (and any remaining variables) cannot be conclusively verified from the provided excerpt.
